items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: Alfred Williams and some of them play drum.

ctx.x: His son Gassum. Mm-hmm. You know what I'm saying. Drum player gets good drum player. Alfred Williams and some of them play drum. Bands player. Well he played the bass himself you know. Who all did Alfred work with? He must have. Oh Alfred went with gun advantage. Alfred left when he was 19's. 19's. 19's. 19's. 19's. 19's. 19's. 1922. Something. And Alfred went to El Paso, Texas. Still out there 16 years. Did you work with him much before he left? No, no. I didn't have a lot of time.
I didn't have a lot of time. I didn't have an opportunity to work with him.
